column1: # Test: Mode gates a live command (engage -> disengage -> re-engage). Drive in auto
#       then switch mode to 0 WHILE a full accelerate+turn command is still being sent.
#       A non-auto mode must block BOTH throttle and steering -- the live autonomous
#       command must not move or turn the trike. Then re-engage auto and confirm it
#       obeys again (proving the block was the mode
# Physics: cruise in auto -> mode 0 with drive+turn still commanded -> stop & center
# Assumption: mode=1 = auto/engaged; any other mode = ignore autonomous drive+steer.
#   A non-auto mode must ignore it: no motion
